title: avis minigames
description: this mod adds 3 game modes from upcoming total conversion mod avis
body:
**Requires Fabric API**

This mod is in beta and will have bugs and strange mechanics.

what this mod adds:
- 3 new game modes (deathmatch, gun game, hunger games)
- a bunch of weapons (guns, bows, crossbow, throwables, melees)
- drawing on your face
- new movement and movement upgrades

important stuff:
- do /avis mode [gamemode] to change the current mode ("normal" disables minigames)
- /avis restartRound, /avis pauseRound, etc
- V to toggle flashlight
- you are always sprinting now, hold sprint key to slow walk
- crouch + jump to high jump (when you have the high jump upgrade)

https://discord.gg/bdYAqbR4Mz
